more_info.overview: Ethyl gallate is an ester combining gallic acid with an ethyl group. It belongs to the gallate family of phenolic compounds. The historical entry identifies an antioxidant function in food. A food-use permission, intake value or manufacturing detail for a different gallate ester cannot be transferred to this preparation.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
